$comment: Machine-readable spec for the ink strip / ink square. Canon card: guidelines/ink-strip.html. Renderers that cannot read CSS vars (canvas, PDF, SVG export, Studio tools) import this file plus day-colours.json. Cell ORDER is fixed; only colour assignment is a parameter.

module.unit: relative — the module is the only dimension; everything else is a multiple

floors.why: below the floor the 1x1 field cells merge into a grey band

strip-h.note: strip-v rotated -90deg; reading order stays red-first, left to right

strip-short-v.note: minors dropped, neutral pair kept — the only sanctioned reduction

square.note: majors as 2x2 quadrants in Z order; field at half module in quadrant 4

square-anchored.note: whole neutral pair kept, two minors dropped; ink takes the outer corner

stock.$comment: A COLOUR, not an absence. Follows the substrate, never the theme. Never transparent, never tinted, never on an outer edge or corner.

void.$comment: A variation move only — the field shows through. The reference mark has NO voids.

full.use: identity only — signage, front page, year poster

majors.use: three plates plus stock — press runs, newsprint

daycode.use: the event mode — hue from day-colours.json

ink.use: one colour — vinyl, laser, emboss, merch

dropout.use: cells left open over a photo, wall or colour field

lit.$comment: PENDING in reality-tokens.json as substrate.lit. Backlit flats bloom into neighbours — keylines are required, Day or Night.

ink.$comment: UNPLATED (decided 19.08.26). Stock reads as a punched chip and the ink cell drops out — the open silhouette IS the Night form. Never lay a cream plate behind a Night mark; a plate is for real cream stock only.

placement.clearSpace: 1 module on all four sides — nothing inside it, including the wordmark
placement.onePerSurface: the frame decides: long edge -> strip, square or tiny frame -> square. Never both in one composition.
placement.outline: none around the whole mark; keylines run BETWEEN cells only
placement.exception: a poster may carry the strip while its footer QR carries the square — separate objects

ratio.$comment: square (4 modules) then matches the code's 33-module outer width exactly

qrPairing.butting: allowed — the quiet zone is already 4 modules of stock, so the mark may sit flush against the code
never: knock a logo into the code
place the mark inside the quiet zone

invariants: cell order is fixed — expose recolouring, never reordering
stock is always an inner cell, always printed, never transparent
dropout: max 3 voids, never two adjacent, never the stock cell
module never below the floor for the chosen form
clear space = 1 module, baked into export bounds
export SVG at integer module sizes so cells stay hairline-free
no radius, no gradient, no cell shadow, no eighth colour
never replaces the wordmark; never appears alone on a first-contact surface
colours are mood, not state — no UI job may be built on it

pending.add: palette carve-out: jobs bind in UI; on artwork all seven inks are mood
